reviewer: Claude (Opus 5.5) review agent reviewer-gfm-a, independent of the extractor lit-gfm-2; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the You et al. 2026 batch (Nat Commun, PMC12780105 and Supplementary Information): 242 records after review (2 sources, 7 models, 13 configurations, 4 datasets, 6 protocols, 55 evaluations, 154 results, 1 claim). All 176 extracted values were checked against Supplementary Tables 4 and 5 by a separate parser (review/review.py); 22 Average Top-k results were rejected to data/omics/pending-review/gfm2-20261011-you2026-topk because their metric concept is not supported. Details in review.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any result.
Values were checked against the supplement's PDF text layer; figures and the Source Data file were not read.
Averaging scheme of F1, precision and recall on the three-class NT-splice-sites-all set is not stated per table.
The GTEx dataset was built by the authors, whose earlier SpTransformer method is one of the compared methods.
corrections: Four SpTransformer evaluations: origin changed to author_reported; the first author developed SpTransformer (ref. 12).
168 NT splice-site records: 500 bp input removed; the source states it for the GTEx task only.
Configurations: SpliceAI and SpTransformer described as retrained under the authors' framework, not as distributed; 500 bp input scoped to the GTEx task.
RNAFM and GENA-LM configurations relinked to existing store families; duplicate model-rna-fm and model-gena-lm removed.
DNABERT and SpTransformer changed from method to model family records (new IDs model-dnabert, model-sptransformer).
GTEx protocols: limitation on best-epoch selection without a named validation split; zero-spread limitation on UTRLM and SpliceAI evaluations.
Rejected: 22 Average Top-k results moved to pending review.
